multitenancy_risks: FKs cascade to auth.users(id) — deleting a user cascades to tenant data; must be preserved when introducing empresa_id.
SET NULL on customer_id/supplier_id/bank_account_id allows orphaned tenant rows; empresa_id backfill must remain intact regardless.
Unique constraints scoped to user_id (categorias_contas_pagar, payment_routing_rules) must become (empresa_id, ...) in F6.
